entries: **Service-status banners for Claude Code, Claude API, and Codex API incidents.** `usage` reads the public Claude and Codex Statuspage.io status pages and shows an orange-red warning banner at the bottom of a panel only when an affected service has an outage or degraded performance. It never calls an LLM usage API.
**Service-status banners work across every panel with a footer.** Each panel uses warning colors matched to its own theme, and a banner for a tool is not shown when that tool's card is hidden.
**Service-status banner text is available in all five UI languages.** Antigravity is not supported because it has no usable public status page.
**Rate and status information now sit side by side in the footers of all eight themed panels.** They now match the default panel instead of being stacked vertically.

**Live usage-rate categories can distinguish heavy use again.** Heavy users previously remained permanently in Heavy because burn rate counted `cache_read`—a near-free prompt-cache reread that reflects conversation length rather than usage intensity—in its numerator. It now excludes `cache_read`, and the Idle / Normal / Active / Heavy thresholds have been recalibrated from 50 / 250 / 1000 to 500 / 2500 / 6000 tokens per minute.
**Popover height now accounts for the service-status banner.** When the banner appears, the panel grows enough to contain it instead of squeezing its content.

title.zh-TW: 服務出狀況時，面板會亮起警示燈
title.en: A warning light now appears when a service is having trouble

body.zh-TW: 你打開 usage 想看 Claude Code 的用量，卻懷疑回應變慢是自己額度用完，還是服務真的故障？現在有頁尾的面板，會在 Claude Code、Claude API 或 Codex API 發生中斷或效能降低時，底部亮起橘紅警示條。它讀的是各家公開的 Statuspage.io 狀態頁，不會呼叫 LLM 用量 API；所以這盞燈只告訴你服務是否出事，不會替你查 AI 用了多少。每個工具用各自面板的警示色，藏起工具卡時也不會冒出它的通知。五種介面語言都有文字說明。這像車上各自獨立的故障燈：引擎、煞車哪一處亮了就看哪一處，沒裝感測器的 Antigravity 則不會硬亮一顆假的燈。
body.en: When usage feels slow, it can be hard to tell whether you hit a limit or the service itself is struggling. Panels with a footer now show an orange-red banner when Claude Code, the Claude API, or the Codex API has an outage or degraded performance. The banner reads each service's public Statuspage.io page; it never calls an LLM usage API, so it reports service health rather than your AI consumption. Each tool uses its own panel colors, and a hidden tool card produces no banner. The wording is available in all five interface languages. Think of separate dashboard lights in a car: the light tells you which fitted component has trouble. Antigravity has no usable public status page, so it does not pretend to have one.

**Service-status banners work across every panel with a footer.** Each panel uses warning colors matched to its own theme, and a banner for a tool is not shown when that tool's card is hidden.
**Service-status banner text is available in all five UI languages.** Antigravity is not supported because it has no usable public status page.

title.zh-TW: 頁尾資訊改成並排，警示出現也不擠內容
title.en: Footer details now sit side by side, with room for warnings

body.zh-TW: 掃過八種主題面板時，現在更容易一眼同時看到用量速度和服務狀態。原本上下堆疊的兩項資訊，已改成和預設面板一致的左右並排；畫面像把兩張便條貼在同一排，而不是一張壓著一張。萬一服務警示條出現，面板也會自己長高，替它留出位置，不再把原有內容擠扁。就像電梯裡加了一則公告，電梯不會因此把樓層按鈕擠到看不清楚，而是多開一塊版面讓內容看清。
body.en: Scanning the eight themed panels now makes it easier to see usage rate and service status at the same time. Those footer details used to be stacked vertically; they now sit side by side, matching the default panel, like two notes placed on one row instead of one covering the other. If a service-status banner appears, the panel also grows tall enough to give it space rather than squeezing the existing content. It is like adding a notice to an elevator without cramming the floor buttons out of sight: the cabin simply makes room.

title.zh-TW: 重度使用判定不再把快取重讀算進去
title.en: Heavy-use labels stop counting cache rereads

body.zh-TW: 明明只是接著同一段對話問問題，usage 卻一直把你標成 Heavy，現在這種誤判會少很多。用量速度會以每分鐘 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）分類成 Idle、Normal、Active、Heavy；先前計算 Heavy 時，把 `cache_read` 也算進使用量。`cache_read` 是提示快取（把已讀過內容暫存，重用時不用重新處理）的重讀，幾乎免費，主要反映對話有多長，不代表你用得多猛。現在它已被排除，門檻也從每分鐘 50／250／1000 調成 500／2500／6000 tokens。像健身房把你反覆看同一張課表當成運動量，當然會虛報；現在只計真正的訓練，標籤比較接近實際強度。
body.en: If usage kept labeling you Heavy while you were only continuing one conversation, that false impression should now be much rarer. The live rate sorts activity into Idle, Normal, Active, and Heavy by tokens per minute—tokens are the units of text an AI processes and bills for. Previously, the Heavy calculation included `cache_read`, a nearly free reread of prompt-cache content that mainly reflects conversation length rather than intensity. That value is now excluded, and the thresholds have moved from 50 / 250 / 1000 to 500 / 2500 / 6000 tokens per minute. It is like a gym counting rereading the same workout sheet as exercise; now it counts the training itself, so the label better matches the effort.

items.original: **Live usage-rate categories can distinguish heavy use again.** Heavy users previously remained permanently in Heavy because burn rate counted `cache_read`—a near-free prompt-cache reread that reflects conversation length rather than usage intensity—in its numerator. It now excludes `cache_read`, and the Idle / Normal / Active / Heavy thresholds have been recalibrated from 50 / 250 / 1000 to 500 / 2500 / 6000 tokens per minute.

entries: **Auto-start 5-hour Session stopped firing at all after its first ping.** 0.28.17 swapped the keeper's elapsed-time throttle for reset-boundary deduplication, which only holds up while the boundary keeps moving — and it doesn't. The ping runs `claude -p` headless, which never triggers Claude Code's statusLine hook, so `usage-status.json` goes on reporting the boundary that was already handled and the keeper wedges permanently. One machine went 23 hours with no auto-opened window while the cooldown-based Antigravity keeper kept working normally. The boundary check stays, since it is what catches a real rollover the moment it happens; a 5h5m cooldown is added alongside it as a second, independent way to re-arm once the payload has gone stale. Every existing gate is untouched, so a live window still never draws a spurious ping.

**Orphaned temp files piled up in `~/.usage/`.** Every atomic write unlinks its `mkstemp` file in a `finally` block, and that block never runs when the app is SIGKILLed or crashes mid-write. One install had collected 40 MB of them over twelve days, dominated by the large JSONL caches whose slow writes are the likeliest to be interrupted. Startup now sweeps `~/.usage` and its direct `*.d` children, deleting only regular files that match the `mkstemp` name shape and have gone untouched for 24 hours — long enough that a second usage process cannot lose a temp file it is still writing. Symlinks and directories are skipped no matter how well their name matches.

title.zh-TW: 5 小時工作階段會重新自動開啟

body.zh-TW: 你靠自動功能守著 5 小時工作階段時，第一個提醒過後不會再整天沒動靜。先前它改用「跨過時段交界才提醒」的判斷，卻因為背景執行的 `claude -p` 不會觸發 statusLine（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）掛鉤，`usage-status.json` 一直留著已處理過的交界時間，於是自動功能永遠不再啟動。現在除了保留交界判斷來即時抓住真正換時段，也加上 5 小時 5 分鐘的冷卻計時；資料太舊時便重新準備下一次提醒。像鬧鐘既會在整點響，也有備用計時器；其中一個卡住，另一個仍會叫你起床。原本避免已開啟工作階段又亂提醒的關卡都還在。
body.en: If you rely on automatic starts to watch a 5-hour session, it will no longer fall silent for the rest of the day after its first alert. The recent switch to detecting a session boundary got stuck because headless `claude -p` does not trigger the statusLine hook, leaving `usage-status.json` stuck on a boundary it had already handled. The boundary check remains, so a real rollover is still caught immediately, but a separate 5-hour-and-5-minute cooldown now rearms the alert once that record is stale. Think of an alarm clock with both a chime and a backup timer: if one gets stuck, the other still wakes you. All the existing checks that prevent an alert during a live session remain in place.

One machine went 23 hours with no auto-opened window while the cooldown-based Antigravity keeper kept working normally. title.zh-TW: 異常中斷留下的暫存檔會自動清理
title.en: Temporary files left by crashes now get cleaned up

body.zh-TW: 程式在寫入資料時若突然當掉或被強制關閉，`~/.usage/` 裡留下的暫存檔現在會被收走，不會越堆越多。正常情況下，原子寫入（先寫好新檔再一次換上去，避免寫到一半壞掉）結束時會刪除 `mkstemp` 產生的檔案；但遇到 SIGKILL（作業系統立刻強制終止程式的訊號）或崩潰，清理步驟來不及跑。一台電腦曾在 12 天累積 40 MB，主要是寫得較慢的 JSONL 快取（把算過／查過的結果暫存起來直接用）。現在啟動時會掃描 `~/.usage/` 和它直接底下的 `*.d` 資料夾，只刪符合名稱、超過 24 小時未碰過的一般檔案；符號連結和資料夾一律不碰。像倉庫每天開門先清昨夜遺下的包材，仍在裝箱的貨不會被誤丟。
body.en: If the app crashes or is forcibly stopped while saving data, its leftover temporary files in `~/.usage/` will now be cleared instead of piling up. An atomic write normally deletes the file made by `mkstemp` after safely putting the completed new file in place, but SIGKILL or a crash prevents that cleanup from running. One installation gathered 40 MB in 12 days, mostly from slower JSONL caches. On startup, Usage now checks `~/.usage/` and its immediate `*.d` children, deleting only ordinary files with the matching temporary-file name that have not been touched for 24 hours. Symlinks and directories are always left alone. It is like a warehouse clearing yesterday's packing scraps each morning without throwing away a box still being packed.

Startup now sweeps `~/.usage` and its direct `*.d` children, deleting only regular files that match the `mkstemp` name shape and have gone untouched for 24 hours — long enough that a second usage process cannot lose a temp file it is still writing. Symlinks and directories are skipped no matter how well their name matches.

entries: **Windows tray now has the same "Auto-start 5-hour session" toggle macOS has had.** Wires the existing `window_keeper` auto-ping logic into `wintray.py`, firing after each refresh; the toggle is in both the tray menu and the HTML panel menu, with Windows-specific enable instructions (Settings → Power & battery) across all five languages. Also adds real-world Windows install-path fallbacks for the `claude`/`agy` binaries.

title.zh-TW: Windows 也能用開關保住五小時工作階段
title.en: Windows can now keep a five-hour session going automatically

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上盯著 Usage 的額度面板，不必再每隔一陣子手動續住工作。系統匣（tray，Windows 右下角收納常駐程式圖示的地方）現在也有 macOS 已有的「自動啟動 5 小時工作階段」開關；在系統匣選單或 HTML 面板選單打開它，程式每次重新整理後都會接上既有的 window_keeper 自動 ping 機制，替這段 5 小時工作階段續著。像替停車計時器開啟自動續費，不用守在旁邊反覆按鈕。若 Windows 阻擋背景運作，畫面也會指向「設定 → 電源與電池」的啟用方法。另補上 claude 與 agy 執行檔（讓指令能啟動程式的檔案）在 Windows 常見安裝位置的備援路徑，找程式時更不易撲空。
body.en: If you keep an eye on Usage's quota panel on Windows, you no longer need to keep a session alive by hand. The system tray now gets the same "Auto-start 5-hour session" switch macOS already had. Turn it on in either the tray menu or HTML panel menu, and each refresh reconnects the existing window_keeper auto-ping logic to keep that five-hour session going. It is like enabling automatic top-ups on a parking meter instead of standing beside it to press a button again and again. If Windows blocks background operation, the app points you to Settings → Power & battery for the enablement steps. It also adds fallback paths for the `claude` and `agy` binaries (files that let a command start a program) in real-world Windows install locations, so the app is less likely to come up empty when looking for them.

Also adds real-world Windows install-path fallbacks for the `claude`/`agy` binaries.

entries: **Antigravity quota showed a stuck, wrong percentage since the CLI's 1.1.5 update.** The Antigravity CLI moved its OAuth credential from a plain file on disk into the macOS Keychain (`security` service `gemini`, account `antigravity`, `go-keyring-base64:`-wrapped JSON) and switched its quota backend from `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` to `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. The card kept reading the now-abandoned token file, which silently refreshed against a stale grant and returned numbers that no longer matched the CLI's own `/quota` output. It now reads the Keychain entry first (falling back to the legacy file), and posts to the current backend.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度卡不再卡在錯誤百分比
title.en: Antigravity quota card no longer gets stuck on a wrong percentage

body.zh-TW: 你在 usage 看 Antigravity 額度時，卡片終於會跟官方 CLI 的 `/quota` 顯示對上。Antigravity CLI 1.1.5 後把 OAuth 憑證（證明你已授權登入的通行證）從硬碟上的普通檔案，搬進 macOS Keychain（Mac 替應用程式保管密碼與登入資料的鑰匙圈）。同時查額度的後端（真正處理查詢的伺服器）也換了地址。卡片卻仍翻舊 token（授權令牌）的檔案；它雖會悄悄更新，拿到的卻是過期授權算出的數字，於是百分比卡住。現在它先讀 Keychain 中 `gemini`／`antigravity` 的資料，找不到才回頭讀舊檔，並改連新版後端。像銀行把帳本搬進保險庫又換了櫃台，舊看板仍對著廢櫃台抄數字；現在先到保險庫、再去正確櫃台，額度才會和 CLI 一致。
body.en: When you check Antigravity quota in usage, its card should finally agree with the official CLI's `/quota` result. Since Antigravity CLI 1.1.5, the OAuth credential (proof that you authorized the sign-in) moved from an ordinary disk file into macOS Keychain, where Macs keep passwords and login data. Its quota backend—the server handling the lookup—also moved. The card kept reading the old token file; it could refresh that abandoned credential, but received numbers based on a stale grant, leaving the percentage stuck and wrong. It now checks the `gemini` / `antigravity` Keychain entry first, falls back to the legacy file only when needed, and calls the new backend. It is like a bank moving its ledger into a vault and changing counters while an old display board still copies figures from the closed counter; now it visits the vault and the right counter first.

items.original: **Antigravity quota showed a stuck, wrong percentage since the CLI's 1.1.5 update.** The Antigravity CLI moved its OAuth credential from a plain file on disk into the macOS Keychain (`security` service `gemini`, account `antigravity`, `go-keyring-base64:`-wrapped JSON) and switched its quota backend from `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` to `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. The card kept reading the now-abandoned token file, which silently refreshed against a stale grant and returned numbers that no longer matched the CLI's own `/quota` output. It now reads the Keychain entry first (falling back to the legacy file), and posts to the current backend.

entries: **Classic popover no longer clips the Claude card when the footer status wraps to two lines.** Long status warnings (e.g. hook broken/restart) push the footer status pill onto a second line, adding roughly 30px the fixed popover height never accounted for; flex then squeezed the overflow-hidden Claude card and clipped its weekly reset row.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session could silently skip a reset boundary.** The keeper's fixed 5-hour self-throttle was measured from the last ping's own timestamp, which could drift out of sync with the real quota reset boundary and occasionally skip a ping entirely — leaving the next window to start only once you talked to Claude yourself. It now dedupes by the actual reset boundary instead of elapsed time, so drift can no longer cause a miss.

title.zh-TW: 狀態警告變長，Claude 卡片不再被切掉
title.en: Long status warnings no longer crop the Claude card

body.zh-TW: 你打開 Classic popover（浮在畫面上的小面板）查看 Claude 用量時，底部跳出很長的警告也不怕最重要的一列消失。以前像 hook 壞掉（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）或需要重新啟動這類狀態訊息一變成兩行，面板固定的高度沒有多留約 30 像素，底部狀態提示就會擠壓 Claude 卡片；卡片又設定成超出範圍不顯示，於是每週重設日期被硬生生切掉。現在面板會替第二行警告留出空間。這像行李箱多塞了一件外套，從前拉鍊一拉就把裡面的行程表夾住；現在箱子會跟著撐開，該看的日期仍完整露在外面。
body.en: When you open the Classic popover to check Claude, a long warning at the bottom will no longer hide the line you came for. Warnings such as a broken hook or a needed restart can wrap onto two lines. The popover's fixed height had not allowed for the extra roughly 30 pixels, so its footer squeezed the Claude card; because overflow was hidden, the weekly reset row got cropped. The panel now makes room for that second line. It is like packing one extra sweater into a suitcase: the old zipper caught the itinerary inside, while the new case expands and keeps the date visible.

items.original: **Classic popover no longer clips the Claude card when the footer status wraps to two lines.** Long status warnings (e.g. hook broken/restart) push the footer status pill onto a second line, adding roughly 30px the fixed popover height never accounted for; flex then squeezed the overflow-hidden Claude card and clipped its weekly reset row.

title.zh-TW: 5 小時自動工作階段不再錯過額度重設
title.en: Five-hour auto sessions no longer miss a quota reset

body.zh-TW: 你把 Auto-start 5-hour Session（每五小時自動維持一次連線的工作階段）交給它跑，現在不會因為時間慢慢飄掉而白白錯過新的額度。原本背後維持連線的 keeper，會用上一次 ping（定時送出的短訊號）的時間開始算五小時；但那個時間可能和真正的額度重設邊界不同步，偶爾便整次略過 ping，下一個使用時段得等你親自跟 Claude 說話才會啟動。現在它改以真正的重設邊界來判斷是否已送過訊號，而不是只看經過多久，所以時鐘漂移不會再漏掉一次。像是每班公車依站牌時刻發車，從前卻拿上一班乘客的下車時間重新計時；現在直接看站牌，下一班便能準時開出。
body.en: If you let Auto-start 5-hour Session keep a session alive, it will no longer miss a fresh quota window because its timing slowly drifts. The keeper used to measure its five-hour throttle from the previous ping's timestamp. That timestamp could fall out of step with the real quota reset boundary, occasionally skipping a ping altogether; the next window then started only after you spoke to Claude yourself. It now deduplicates pings against the actual reset boundary, not simply elapsed time, so drift cannot cause a miss. Think of a bus that used to schedule its next departure from the last passenger's exit time; it now follows the timetable at the stop.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session could silently skip a reset boundary.** The keeper's fixed 5-hour self-throttle was measured from the last ping's own timestamp, which could drift out of sync with the real quota reset boundary and occasionally skip a ping entirely — leaving the next window to start only once you talked to Claude yourself. It now dedupes by the actual reset boundary instead of elapsed time, so drift can no longer cause a miss.

entries: **Idle CPU and disk I/O cut significantly across the board.** History scanning now uses FSEvents-reported paths to stat only changed files instead of re-walking and stat'ing every Claude/Codex session JSONL (thousands of files) on every refresh tick; a full rescan still runs periodically as a safety net. Startup no longer unconditionally re-downloads the pricing table or checks for updates — both now respect their existing cache freshness windows. Codex rate-limit reads reuse the same file index instead of re-scanning session directories, and SQLite reads (thread metadata, rate limits) are skipped entirely when the underlying database file hasn't changed. The on-disk parse cache is now sharded into 32 buckets so a single active session only rewrites its own shard instead of the whole multi-megabyte cache file.

title.zh-TW: 閒置時少做白工，Usage 更省 CPU 與硬碟
title.en: Usage stops doing busywork while idle, saving CPU and disk activity

body.zh-TW: 電腦明明沒在操作 Usage，CPU 與硬碟卻不該一直忙著翻舊帳。這版把背景整理改成像圖書館只查看剛歸還的書：它會依 FSEvents（macOS 告知哪些檔案改過的通知）只挑出有變動的檔案。於是它只讀取有變動的 Claude、Codex 工作階段 JSONL（每行存一筆資料的紀錄檔），不再每次更新都重翻成千上萬個檔案；仍會定期全面檢查，避免漏掉變更。啟動時，價格表與更新檢查也會尊重既有快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的有效期限，不再每次重抓。Codex 的限流資料會共用檔案索引，SQLite（放在單一檔案裡的小型資料庫）檔沒變就不讀；解析快取更分成 32 份，活躍工作階段只改自己的那份。結果是閒置時明顯減少 CPU 與硬碟讀寫，啟動也少做無謂工作。
body.en: When you are not even using Usage, your CPU and disk should not be stuck riffling through old records. This release makes its background housekeeping work like a library checking only books that were just returned: FSEvents, macOS notifications about changed files, tells it which files to inspect. It now reads only changed Claude and Codex session JSONL logs, rather than re-walking and checking thousands of files on every refresh; a full scan still runs from time to time as a safety net. On startup, the pricing table and update check now honor their existing cache, saved results that remain valid for a while, instead of downloading again every time. Codex rate-limit reads share the file index, unchanged SQLite database files are skipped, and the parse cache is split into 32 buckets so an active session rewrites only its own. The result: substantially less idle CPU and disk I/O, plus less needless work at launch.

Startup no longer unconditionally re-downloads the pricing table or checks for updates — both now respect their existing cache freshness windows. Codex rate-limit reads reuse the same file index instead of re-scanning session directories, and SQLite reads (thread metadata, rate limits) are skipped entirely when the underlying database file hasn't changed. The on-disk parse cache is now sharded into 32 buckets so a single active session only rewrites its own shard instead of the whole multi-megabyte cache file.

title.zh-TW: 自動接棒改用同一開關，Antigravity 不再被假倒數騙住
title.en: One switch now runs both keepers, without Antigravity's fake countdown

body.zh-TW: 你替 Claude 或 Antigravity 開過自動接棒，現在不用記得兩個開關在哪裡：它們合成同一個選項，打開後兩位視窗守護者會一起啟動；先前只開其中一項的人，也會自動視為兩項都開啟。Antigravity 的額度 API（程式用來取得額度資料的介面）在額度還有 100% 時，仍會回報「約五小時後重設」。這只是尚未使用的滑動視窗（從第一次使用才開始計時的五小時時段）預留時間，不是已在倒數。舊版誤認工作階段正在跑，讓自動接棒從不觸發；現在會把 100% 視為沒有進行中的時段，符合條件就可自動接棒，五小時防連續觸發仍保留。額度卡也會顯示「Quota full」，不再拿假倒數嚇你。
body.en: If you enabled automatic handoff for either Claude or Antigravity, you no longer need to hunt for two switches. They are now one shared toggle: turn it on and both keepers start; anyone who had enabled either old switch is automatically treated as having enabled both. This also fixes Antigravity's phantom countdown. Its quota API (the program connection used to retrieve quota data) reported “in about five hours” even with 100% remaining. That is reserved time for a sliding window (a five-hour period whose clock starts only with first use), not a running countdown. The old gate mistook it for an active session, so it never launched. At 100% remaining, it treats the window as inactive and can launch, while its five-hour self-throttle remains. The card shows “Quota full” until then. Like one relay-race switch: both runners get ready together, but the clock counts down only after the race begins.

entries: **Antigravity can now auto-start its next 5-hour session.** A new opt-in menu toggle watches fresh, non-mock agy quota results and, when the selected model group's session is fully reset with no countdown running, dispatches one background `agy -p ok --model 'Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low)'`. title.zh-TW: 下一個五小時工作階段可自動接棒
title.en: Your next five-hour session can start itself

body.zh-TW: 你剛用完 Antigravity 的五小時工作階段（session，一段可使用的固定時段），不想守著倒數等下一輪，現在可以在選單手動開啟自動接棒。它會查看最新、非模擬的 agy 額度結果；只有所選模型群組已完全重設且沒有倒數時，才在背景執行一次本機 agy CLI（命令列工具）的指定指令來開啟下一段。這個選項預設關閉，開過一次後五小時內不會重複觸發，也只使用你電腦上的 agy CLI。像接力賽交棒：跑者真的回到起跑線、計時器歸零才交棒，不會提早衝出去；開啟時也會顯示和 Claude 視窗守護功能相同的 Mac 睡眠提醒。
body.en: Finished an Antigravity five-hour session and don't want to watch the clock for the next one? You can now opt into an automatic handoff from the menu. It watches fresh, real agy quota results and, only when your chosen model group has fully reset with no countdown running, launches one specified command through the local agy CLI in the background. It is off by default, will not fire again for five hours, and uses only the agy CLI on your computer. Think of a relay race: the baton moves only after the runner is back at the starting line and the clock is at zero, never early. Enabling it also shows the same Mac sleep warning as the Claude window keeper.

entries: **Auto-start 5-hour Session now actually fires**: the `claude` CLI resolution list was missing `~/.local/bin/claude` (where the native installer puts it), so inside the `.app` bundle's narrow `PATH` the ping silently found nothing to run and gave up. Also hardened against a false "expired" read: the reset-time check now only trusts the live statusLine hook data source (fallback sources can default a missing `resets_at` to parse time, which the next refresh would misread as already-expired) and requires the expiry to be at least 2 minutes old before firing, filtering out that false positive without meaningfully delaying a real away-from-keyboard ping. Dialog copy from 0.28.12 also simplified — leads with "pauses on sleep, resumes on wake, nothing to manage" and routes the sleep-setting instructions through System Settings search (the exact pane/wording varies by Mac model and macOS version) with a fallback suggestion to ask Claude Code to walk through it.

title.zh-TW: 離席自動起跑，現在真的會啟動也不會誤響
title.en: Away-time auto-start now runs reliably without false alarms

body.zh-TW: 你離開電腦前開啟 Auto-start 5-hour Session（下個 5 小時階段自動啟動），它現在就會準時啟動。Mac App 的 `PATH` 很窄，找指令的名單漏掉原生安裝器放置 `claude` CLI（從終端機下指令操作 Claude 的工具）的 `~/.local/bin/claude`，背景 ping 找不到可執行項目便放棄；已補上。它也只信任 statusLine hook（會提供終端機底部狀態列資料、在特定事件觸發的小程式）的即時資料來判斷重設時間，避免備援來源把缺少的 `resets_at` 當成剛解析時間，下一次刷新又誤認額度已過期。到期滿兩分鐘才 ping，濾掉誤報，離席自動啟動不會明顯變慢。像定時洗衣機終於找得到插座，也不會把剛按下的按鈕誤當成洗完。說明視窗改成先講睡眠會暫停、醒來會恢復；睡眠設定改用 System Settings 搜尋。
body.en: Turn on Auto-start 5-hour Session before stepping away, and it will now fire on time. The Mac app's `.app` bundle has a narrow `PATH`, and its command lookup list had omitted `~/.local/bin/claude`, where the native installer puts the `claude` CLI. The background ping could find nothing to run and quietly give up; that location is now included. The reset-time check also now trusts only live statusLine hook data, supplied by a small program that is triggered by particular events and feeds the terminal's bottom status bar, rather than fallback data that can treat a missing `resets_at` value as the parsing time and later mistake it for an expired session. It waits until expiry is at least two minutes old before pinging, filtering that false alarm without meaningfully delaying a real away-time auto-start. Think of a timed washing machine that can finally find its outlet and no longer mistakes a freshly pressed button for a completed wash. The dialog now leads with the important bit: it pauses during sleep and resumes on wake. Sleep instructions send you to System Settings search, so you do not have to hunt through differently named panes on different Macs or macOS versions.

Also hardened against a false "expired" read: the reset-time check now only trusts the live statusLine hook data source (fallback sources can default a missing `resets_at` to parse time, which the next refresh would misread as already-expired) and requires the expiry to be at least 2 minutes old before firing, filtering out that false positive without meaningfully delaying a real away-from-keyboard ping. entries: **New opt-in menu toggle: Auto-start 5-hour Session.** When enabled, usage detects that your Claude 5-hour quota window has just reset and no session is currently running, then fires a single `claude -p ok --model haiku` in the background to immediately start the next window — useful if you're stepping away and want the next 5 hours counting down before you're back. Off by default; sends at most once per 5-hour window (self-throttled), never touches the Anthropic quota API, and silently no-ops if the `claude` CLI can't be found. Enabling it shows a one-time dialog explaining that it needs usage (and the Mac) to stay awake to fire — closing the lid always sleeps the Mac regardless of this setting.

title.zh-TW: 離席時，讓下一個 5 小時額度窗口先起跑
title.en: Start your next 5-hour window while you're away

body.zh-TW: 要離開電腦吃飯或出門，卻不想回來才開始等下一輪 Claude 額度嗎？usage 新增可自行開啟的「Auto-start 5-hour Session」選項。它發現 5 小時 quota window（Claude 額度每 5 小時重新計算的一段時間）剛重設、而且目前沒有執行中的 session（一次持續運作的工作階段）時，會在背景送出一次 `claude -p ok --model haiku`，立刻替下一個窗口起跑。像替洗衣機設好延後啟動：你人不在，倒數仍先開始；每個窗口最多只送一次，不會反覆叫醒它。這項功能預設關閉，不會碰 Anthropic 的 quota API（查詢額度的程式介面）；找不到 `claude` CLI（從終端機下指令操作 Claude 的工具）也會安靜略過。開啟時會先說明 usage 和 Mac 必須保持醒著，但闔上筆電仍照常讓 Mac 睡眠。
body.en: Heading out for lunch or errands and don't want your next Claude allowance window to start only when you return? usage now has an opt-in Auto-start 5-hour Session toggle. When it sees that a 5-hour quota window has reset and no session is running, it sends one background `claude -p ok --model haiku` command to start the next window immediately. Think of it like scheduling a washing machine: the countdown can begin while you're away, but it runs at most once per window rather than repeatedly nudging the machine. It is off by default, never calls Anthropic's quota API, and quietly does nothing if the `claude` CLI is unavailable. On setup, it explains that usage and your Mac need to stay awake; closing the lid still puts your Mac to sleep as usual.
